payload.claim: The new witness (tests/test_context.py::test_the_implement_prompt_leaves_running_wrong_versions_to_the_host) only checks that one paragraph contains the four substrings 'mutant', '`witness`', 'REVIEW' and 'host'; it never checks which direction the paragraph points. Rewording the closing clause of step 4 from 'but do not run them yourself: your turn is for making the witnesses and the change pass' to 'and you may run them yourself too: your turn is for running the witnesses and the change pass' keeps every one of those four tokens in the same paragraph, so the test still passes, while it reverses the exact instruction this change exists to add (the implementer must not burn its own turn running the spec's listed wrong versions). No gate reads prompt semantics, so this reversal would be invisible to CI though it defeats the backlog item's whole point.
